title: Avia, ry mino, faly fa mpandresy.
sourceKeyText: LA no DO (then MI no DO; returns to LA no DO)
meterSource: 4/4 is an editorial reading of paired printed half-bars, not an explicit time signature in the photo.

measures.notesAboutNotation: There is a printed double bar before the next phrase’s pickup (soprano d, alto s₁, tenor m). It was placed in final pulse here to retain sequential event timing.

lines: Avia, ry mino, faly fa mpandresy,
He! tonga Jeso Tompon’ ny anjely;
Tompon’ ny tompo sy Mpanjaka Izy,
Fa tsy nanda ho zanak’ i Maria;
Dera sy haja raisonao, ry Jeso,
Tenin’ ny Ray, kanefa tonga nofo

notationConventions.raw: Colon separates successive pulse cells; | is the visual midpoint separator when two printed two-pulse spans are grouped as one 4/4 measure.
notationConventions.dash: — continues the preceding note; an empty cell indicates no printed note.
notationConventions.keyChanges: Key changes are indicated by measure.key and measure.sourceKeyText, with MIDI pitches recalculated accordingly.
notationConventions.playbackInterpretation: Provisional 4/4 quarter-beat grouping; dotted notation and sustained notes encoded but not independently proofread.

issues: The photograph prints tonal centers LA no DO, MI no DO, LA no DO, but no numeric time signature or BPM. The 4/4 pairing and default tempo are editorial assumptions.
The little prior-key sol-fa notes above the initial notes at both key-change points are key-transition equivalents, not separate sounding notes.
Opening anacrusis and internal pickup at the third-system double bar have been interpreted in 4/4 timing; the exact barline placement needs music-editor confirmation.
At the beginning of the last repeated refrain the printed lowest row is blank for several spans; do not infer unprinted notes.
Pitch registers are editorial SATB defaults. The displayed raw sol-fa is more trustworthy than the MIDI register or rhythm lengths.
Underline grouping, multiple dynamics, and lyric alignment across four verses are not fully encoded.
